mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a business entity and not a humanitarian organisation."
A cooperative is a business entity and not a humanitarian organisation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are responsible and have obligations to the equity capital of the cooperatives on equal proportion."
The members are responsible and have obligations to the equity capital of the cooperatives on equal proportion.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a circle of people with more homogeneous key interests."
A group is a circle of people with more homogeneous key interests.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used for the benefit of all the members."
Proceeds from the farm are used for the benefit of all the members.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the major motive for joining or forming a cooperative."
Meeting economic needs is the major motive for joining or forming a cooperative.
fib: ______ is a society that is mainly concerned with only one activity.
A single-purpose cooperative is a society that is mainly concerned with only one activity.
______ is the relationship between a cooperative organisation, as a business entity and member's private business enterprise or household economy.
Cooperative nexus is the relationship between a cooperative organisation, as a business entity and member's private business enterprise or household economy.

Related to this factor is the need to also audit the accounts before the annual general meeting is held.

Discuss Cooperative enterprise is the soul of cooperative economics.
